title: The Music Lovers
writer: Melvyn Bragg, Catherine Drinker Bowen, Barbara von Meck
actors: Richard Chamberlain, Glenda Jackson, Max Adrian
plot: Piano teacher Peter Ilych Tchaikovsky struggles against his latent homosexuality by getting married. Unfortunately he chooses nymphomaniac Antonina Milyukova, a depressed former student whom he cannot satisfy.
